blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Speech-based Alzheimer’s disease (AD) assessments increasingly rely on pretrained self-supervised learning (SSL) models that learn acoustic representations directly from raw audio, exposing the model to recording factors.
We ask whether such factors are merely encoded in SSL representations or can systematically alter predictions. Using ADReSSo and three large SSL backbones, we apply controlled noise and reverberation interventions to participant-speech-only, non-speech, and full-recording audio. We combine layer-wise linear decoding, input- and representation-space interventions, and geometric alignment analysis to distinguish acoustic decodability from influence on AD prediction.
Our results show that controlled acoustic interventions alter AD predictions across all three SSL backbones. Noise, despite showing no significant diagnostic-group difference in the original data, produces the strongest intervention effects. Importantly, these effects are systematically structured relative to the classifier’s decision direction, replicate on the held-out test set and reverse when the representation-space intervention direction is reversed. Together, these findings show that high predictive performance and the absence of a significant diagnostic-group difference in a measured acoustic factor are not sufficient for robustness. We argue that intervention-based robustness tests should become standard for trustworthy clinical speech models.
blocks.zh:
基于语音的阿尔茨海默氏病(AD)评估越来越依赖于预先训练的自学(SSL)模型,这些模型直接从原始音频中学习声学表现,使模型暴露于记录因素.
我们问,这些因素是仅仅在SSL表述中编码,还是能够系统地改变预测。 使用ADReSSo和三个大型的SSL主干线,我们把可控噪声和反响干扰应用到只讲参与者的,不讲的,以及全录音的音频上. 我们结合了分层线性解码、输入和表示空间干预以及几何校正分析,以区分声学可解码性和对AD预测的影响。
我们的结果显示,控制性声学干预改变了所有三个SSL主干线的AD预测. 噪声虽然在原始数据中显示没有显著的诊断组差异,但会产生最强的干预效果. 重要的是,这些影响是相对于分类者的决定方向而有系统的结构化的,在搁置测试中复制,并在表示空间干预方向倒置时倒置。 这些调查结果加在一起表明,高预测性能和在所测量的声学因子中缺乏显著的诊断-组分差异不足以维持稳健性. 我们主张,基于干预的强性测试应该成为值得信赖的临床语音模型的标准.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Speech-based assessments offer a scalable, non-invasive approach to Alzheimer’s disease (AD) detection [ 12 , 26 ] . Recent systems increasingly rely on self-supervised learning (SSL) models pretrained on large-scale, predominantly non-clinical speech corpora [ 2 , 16 , 8 ] . Because these models learn directly from raw audio, their representations encode acoustic factors across layers [ 32 ] , which may provide unintended cues for downstream AD classifiers. Recent work suggests that this risk is not merely theoretical. Gauder et al. [ 13 ] and Liu et al. [ 25 ] showed that AD can be predicted from non-speech ( NS ) segments containing silence and background acoustics such as noise. While these findings show that NS regions carry diagnostic information, they leave open whether acoustic factors still influence AD predictions when speech content is available.
blocks.zh: 基于言论的评估为阿尔茨海默症的检测提供了一种可扩展的、非侵入性的方法[12,26]。 最近的系统越来越依赖于自我监督的学习模式(SSL)在大规模,以非临床语音公司为主的预训上[2,16,8]. 因为这些模型直接从原始音频中学习,它们的表达式将声学因子编码到多层[32],这可能为下游AD分级器提供出乎意料的提示. 最近的工作表明,这种风险不仅仅是理论上的。 高德等 [13]和刘等. [25] 显示AD可以从含有静音和噪音等背景相声的非声段(NS.)来预测. 虽然这些调查结果表明,NS区域载有诊断性信息,但当有语音内容时,声学因素是否仍会影响AD的预测,则会留有余地.

blocks.en: In this work, we ask whether acoustic factors are merely decodable from SSL representations or whether they systematically influence downstream AD predictions. This distinction is important because the presence of acoustic information alone does not establish that a classifier functionally relies on it. We therefore move beyond observational decoding and intervene on controlled noise and reverberation both in input space and in the corresponding representation space. By comparing participant-only ( PAT ), full-recording ( FULL ), and non-speech ( NS ) streams, we test whether the classifier sensitivity to these interventions persists when genuine speech content is available. We further analyse the geometry of the induced representation shifts relative to the AD decision direction to test whether intervention effects are directionally structured.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们询问,声学因素是否仅能从SSL的表示中解码出,或者它们是否系统地影响下游的反倾销预测. 这种区分很重要,因为仅存在声学信息并不能确定一个分类者在功能上依赖于它. 因此,我们在输入空间和相应的代表空间都超越了观测解码和干预控制噪音和反响。 通过比较只参与者(PAT),全记录(FulL),和非语音(NS)流,我们测试当有真实的语音内容时,对这些发言的分类敏感性是否持续. 我们进一步分析与反倾销决定方向相比,诱发的表达方式变化的几何特征,以检验干预效果是否具有方向结构。

blocks.en: We evaluate this framework on ADReSSo using three large SSL backbones and controlled real and synthetic noise and reverberation degradations. Across models, both input- and representation-space interventions alter AD predictions. Noise produces the strongest changes despite showing no significant diagnostic-group difference in the original recordings. Importantly, the resulting shifts are directionally structured, replicate on the held-out test set, and reverse when the representation-space intervention direction is reversed. Together, these findings show that intervening on acoustic factors systematically shifts downstream AD predictions. Our contributions are threefold: (i) an intervention-based framework that distinguishes acoustic decodability from functional influence on AD predictions; (ii) controlled input- and representation-space interventions showing that acoustic manipulations systematically shift predictions even when speech content is available; and (iii) cross-backbone and held-out validation showing that these effects generalise, are directionally structured and reversible in intervention space. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/neselidondurma/beyond-decode .
blocks.zh: 我们利用三个大型SSL主干线对ADReSSo进行这一框架的评估,并控制了真实和合成的噪音和反震降解。 在整个模型中,投入和代表空间干预都改变了反倾销预测。 噪音产生最强的变化,尽管在原始录音中没有显示显著的诊断组差异. 重要的是,由此产生的变化是方向结构化的,在搁置试验中重复,在表示空间干预方向倒转时倒置。 这些调查结果表明,对声学因素的干预系统地改变了下游的反倾销预测。 我们的贡献有三个方面:(一) 基于干预的框架,将声学可解码性与对AD预测的功能影响区分开来;(二) 有控制的输入和表示空间干预,表明声学操纵即使在有语音内容时也会系统地改变预测;和(三) 有交叉后骨和被搁置的验证,表明这些效果一般化,在干涉空间具有方向结构化和可逆性. 守则可在https://github.com/neselidondurma/beyond-decode上公开查阅。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集和质量控制

blocks.en:
We use the official age- and gender-balanced train ( n = 166 n=166 ) and test ( n = 71 n=71 ) speaker-disjoint splits from the ADReSSo challenge, comprising Cookie Theft picture-description recordings [ 27 ] . Table 1 reports mean ± \pm standard deviation of MMSE [ 11 ] and two acoustic factors for healthy controls (HC) and participants with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) across train and test splits: WADA-SNR [ 18 ] , hereafter SNR, measuring background noise, and SRMR [ 10 ] , measuring reverberation.
Diagnostic-group differences are assessed using the Mann-Whitney U U test [ 28 ] .
As expected, diagnostic score MMSE differs significantly by diagnosis in both splits, whereas SNR does not. In contrast, SRMR is significantly higher in AD in the training split ( p < .001 p<.001 ) but not in the test ( p = .216 p=.216 ).
This split-dependent acoustic structure motivates our controlled interventions.
blocks.zh:
我们使用官方年龄和性别平衡的列车(n = 166 n = 166)和测试(n = 71 n = 71) 扬声器-脱节从ADReSSo挑战中分出,包含 Cookie 被窃图片-描述录音 [27]. 表1报告指MMSE[11]的±\pm标准偏差,以及健康控制的两个声学因素(HC)和阿尔茨海默病(AD)的参与者在列车和测试分道扬镳:WADA-SNR [18],以下简称SNR,测量背景噪声,以及SRMR [10],测量回响.
诊断-组别差异通过曼恩-惠特尼U U测试评估[28].
如所料,诊断分数MMSE因两种分数的诊断而有很大差异,而SNR则不然. 相比之下,在AD中,在训练分出(p <.001 p <.001)中,SRMR明显更高,但在测试中则不高(p=216 p=216).
这种分化依赖的相声结构激励着我们控制下的干预.

blocks.en:
To examine whether acoustic factor influence differs across recording regions, we construct three streams: PAT , FULL , and NS . Because segmentation errors have been reported [ 3 ] , we apply voice activity detection (VAD; pyannote.audio v3.4 ) [ 5 , 4 ] . We define PAT as VAD-positive regions overlapping the provided participant timestamps, NS as VAD-negative regions, and FULL as the complete recording.
Selected regions are processed separately to avoid artificial acoustic discontinuities [ 22 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们构建出三条流:PAT、FLL和NS。 因为分区错误已经报告[3],我们应用了语音活性检测(VAD;pyannote.audio v3.4.)[5,4]. 我们把PAT定义为VAD阳性区域,与所提供的参与者时间戳相重叠;NS定义为VAD阴性区域;FUL则是完整的记录。
部分区域分别进行加工,避免人工相声断断[22,6].

blocks.en: 2.2 Counterfactual Data Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 反事实数据生成

blocks.en:
To assess how controlled interventions on acoustic factors
affect AD predictions, we generate counterfactual recordings in a 2 × 2 × 4 2\times 2\times 4 design, spanning two acoustic factors (noise/reverberation, as motivated in Sec. 2.1 ), two sources (real ( R )/ synthetic ( S )), and four degradation severity levels D1 → \rightarrow D4 (mild → \rightarrow severe). Noise is introduced additively: R employs environmental recordings from MUSAN [ 36 ] , whereas S applies Gaussian noise at SNR levels of 20 , 10 , 5 , 20,10,5, and 0 0 dB, following established noisy-speech evaluation literature [ 15 ] . Reverberation is introduced convolutively using room impulse responses (RIRs): R uses measured RIRs from OpenSLR-28 [ 21 ] , while S applies RIRs simulated with pyroomacoustics [ 34 ] , targeting T 60 T_{60} values of 0.3 , 0.5 , 0.7 0.3,0.5,0.7 and 0.9 0.9 s, following and extending the REVERB Challenge settings [ 19 ] .
For real noise interventions, the same waveform is retained across D1-D4, severity controlled only through amplitude scaling.
All acoustic degradations are first applied to FULL , after which PAT and NS are reconstructed using the fixed timestamps from Sec. 2.1 .
blocks.zh:
评估如何控制声学因素的干预
影响AD预测,我们以2×2×4 2×2×4 2×4的设计生成反事实录音,涉及两个声学因素(噪音/反响,如第2.1节所激发的),两个来源(真实(R)/合成(S)),四个降解严重度等级为D1−\右倾D4(密克罗-\右倾严重). 添加了噪音: R使用来自MUSAN [36] 的环境录音,而S在SNR 20, 10, 5, 20, 10, 5和 0 dB 的级别上应用高斯噪音, 利用室冲动反应(RIRs)曲折地引入了逆转: R使用从OpenSLR-28 [21]所测量的RIRs,而S应用了用烟道声学模拟的RIRs [34],目标是T 60 T_{60}值为:0.3,0.5,0.3,0.5,0.7和0.9 s,遵循并扩展了REVERB挑战设置 [19].
对于真正的噪声干预,在D1-D4之间保留了同样的波形,严重性只能通过振幅缩放来控制.
所有声学退化首先被应用到FLL.,之后PAT和NS使用从Sec.2.1.的固定时间戳来重建.

blocks.en: 2.3 Feature Extraction and Prediction Framework
blocks.zh: 2.3 采掘和预测框架

blocks.en:
We downmix recordings to mono, resample them to 16 kHz, and extract mean-pooled representations from each layer of three large SSL backbones with distinct pre-training objectives: Wav2Vec2-Large [ 2 ] , HuBERT-Large [ 16 ] , and WavLM-Large [ 8 ] . We use Ridge regression for continuous targets (SNR, SRMR and MMSE) and logistic regression for AD classification. Linear models are chosen for their strong performance in ADReSSo [ 7 ] and because they provide an explicit AD-discriminative direction, needed for subsequent analyses.
We evaluate all models using 5-fold nested cross-validation (NCV) on the training set ( n = 166 n=166 ), with feature standardization [ 35 ] and regularization tuning within inner folds. We apply the full experimental framework to all three backbones and present HuBERT in the main results, as it achieves the highest AD performance (BA = 0.87 =0.87 ). After fixing all analysis choices from NCV, we retrain on the full training set and evaluate it once on the held-out test set ( n = 71 ) (n=71) .
blocks.zh:
我们把录音调低到单声道,把它们重新做成16千赫,并从三个大型SSL主干线的每一层抽取平均集合的表示,具有不同的训练前目标: Wav2Vec2-Large [2],HuBERT-Large [16],和WavLM-Large [8]. 我们对连续目标(SNR、SRMR和MSE)采用Ridge回归,对反倾销分类采用后勤回归。 线性模型是因其在ADReSSo[7]中的强性能而选择的,因为这些模型为以后的分析提供了明确的AD-歧视方向。
我们在训练集(n = 166 n = 166)上评价所有使用5倍嵌入式交叉验证(NCV)的模型,特征标准化[35],并进行内叠内调节. 我们把完整的实验框架应用于所有三个骨干,并在主要结果中呈现出HuBERT,因为它实现了最高的AD性能(BA=0.87=0.87). 在确定NCV的所有分析选择后,我们重新对全套培训进行训练,并在被搁置的测试集(n=71)(n=71)上评价一次。

blocks.zh: 2.4 实验框架

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: E1, Linear Decoding: We first probe how acoustic and clinical information is distributed across HuBERT layers. In Fig. 1 , acoustic factors show distinct depth profiles. SNR remains highly linearly decodable across layers and streams, reaching R 2 ≈ 0.8 R^{2}\approx 0.8 in FULL , whereas SRMR is decodable in early layers of the speech-containing PAT and FULL streams ( R 2 ≈ 0.6 R^{2}\approx 0.6 ) and declines markedly with depth. In contrast, MMSE decodability in PAT and FULL increases across the layers, reaching R 2 ≈ 0.5 R^{2}\approx 0.5 in later layers. AD classification performance is strongest in intermediate layers, peaking at layer 12 ( ℓ AD ∗ \ell_{\mathrm{AD}}^{*} ). Notably, NS retains strong SNR information and above-chance AD classification, while SRMR and MMSE are essentially not linearly decodable, consistent with SRMR’s reliance on speech modulation structure that is largely absent from NS.
blocks.zh: E1 线性解码 : 我们首先探索声学和临床信息如何在HuBERT层之间分布. 在图1中,声学因子显示出明显的深度剖面. SNR在分层和分流之间仍然具有高度的线性可解码性,在FLL中达到R 2 → 0.8 R^{2 → 0.8 → 0.8分;而SRMR则在含有语音的PAT和FLL分流(R 2 → 0.6 R^{2 → 0.6分)的早期分层中可解码并随着深度明显下降. 相形之下,PAT和FLL中的MMSE可解码性在多层之间递增,在后层达到R 2 → 0.5 R^{2 → 0.5左右. AD分类性能在中间层最强,最高峰为第12层 (l AD ∗\ell mathrm{AD}). 值得注意的是,NS保留了强大的SNR信息和高于常规的AD分类,而SRMR和MMSE基本上不是线性可解码的,这与SRMR对语音调制结构的依赖是一致的,后者在NS中基本上不存在.

blocks.en: E2 & E4, Input-space Intervention & Alignment: We next test whether controlled acoustic interventions alter AD predictions across HuBERT layers. Fig. 2 a shows that SNR degradation causes substantially more prediction flips than SRMR when clean and degraded inputs are evaluated with the same frozen layer-wise classifier f ℓ , AD ( s , k ) f_{\ell,\mathrm{AD}}^{(s,k)} . The largest difference occurs in FULL at ℓ = 1 \ell=1 , with flip rates of 51 % 51\% for SNR(S) versus 8 % 8\% for SRMR(S). Flip rates generally increase with degradation severity (D1 → \rightarrow D4). NS under SNR is the main exception, with even D1 producing flip rates comparable to D4, indicating high SNR sensitivity of non-speech regions. Fig. 2 b shows the direction of these flips, averaged across D1–D4. Under SRMR interventions, AD → \rightarrow HC flips dominate in PAT and FULL , whereas HC → \rightarrow AD flips dominate in NS . Under SNR interventions, the clearest asymmetry occurs in NS , where AD → \rightarrow HC flips dominate. Fig. 2 c provides the corresponding geometric view at ℓ AD ∗ \ell_{\mathrm{AD}}^{*} , with positive cosine similarity indicating alignment toward AD. Overall, 44/48 conditions (91.7%) fall outside the central 95% range of n = 100 n=100 magnitude-matched random directions. As expected for a linear classifier, the alignment patterns correspond closely to the directional flips: under SRMR, PAT and FULL shift mainly toward HC while NS shifts toward AD. Under SNR, NS remains strongly HC-directed, whereas PAT and FULL show a severity-dependent shift toward AD as degradation increases.

blocks.en: E3 & E4, Representation-space Intervention & Alignment: We next test whether the input-space sensitivity observed in E2 also appears when acoustic degradation directions are introduced directly in representation space. Fig. 3 a shows clear layer-dependent steering effects, with consistently higher flip rates for SNR than SRMR. The largest effect occurs at r ∗ = 9 r^{*}=9 , where steering along the D4 SNR-derived direction in FULL flips 42 % 42\% of predictions. This peak is not explained by perturbation magnitude, since ρ r \rho_{r} decreases with depth, from 83 83 at r = 0 r=0 to 64 64 at r = 9 r=9 . Fig. 3 b shows that these flips are predominantly AD → \rightarrow HC in the speech-containing PAT and FULL streams for both SNR- and SRMR-derived directions. NS differs: SNR steering remains HC-directed, whereas SRMR produces fewer, predominantly AD-directed flips. Similarly, Fig. 3 c shows that PAT and FULL shifts are mainly aligned toward HC and often fall outside the central 95% range of n = 100 n=100 magnitude-matched random directions. Finally, reversing the steering coefficient from α = + 1 \alpha=+1 to − 1 -1 reverses the logit effect ( r Pearson = − 0.98 r_{\mathrm{Pearson}}=-0.98 ), demonstrating strong directional reversibility.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
A common assumption in speech-based clinical AI is that high predictive performance and no significant group differences in measured acoustic factors imply robust predictions. Our results challenge this assumption directly: acoustic interventions alter AD predictions in both input and representation space, including for SNR despite no significant group difference. This extends prior decodability [ 31 ] and non-speech-only studies [ 25 , 13 , 17 ] by showing that interventions on acoustic factors influence predictions even when genuine speech content is available. E4 further shows that these intervention effects are not captured by a single direction: alignment varies across factors, streams, and severities, and input- and representation-space interventions can shift decisions differently.
This heterogeneity argues against a simple fix based on identifying and projecting out a single global ‘acoustic confound direction,’ and instead suggests a more distributed sensitivity.
blocks.zh:
基于语音的临床AI中一个常见的假设是,高预测性能和所测量的声学因子中没有显著的群体差异意味着强势的预测. 我们的结果直接质疑这一假设:声学干预改变了在投入和表示空间(包括国家自然资源局)的反倾销预测,尽管没有明显的群体差异。 这扩展了以前的可解码性[31]和不只发表言论的研究[25,13,17],表明即使有真实的语音内容,对声学因素的干预也会影响预测. E4进一步表明,这些干预效果并非由一个单一方向来捕捉:各种因素、流和断裂的配合各不相同,投入和代表空间干预可改变不同的决定。
这种异质性反对基于识别和预测出单一的全球"声波混乱方向"的简单定律,相反地暗示出一种分布更分明的敏感性.

blocks.en: These findings have a direct practical implication: The absence of a statistically significant group difference in an acoustic factor is not sufficient evidence of robustness. In our data, SNR showed no significant group difference, yet produced the largest intervention-induced flips. Clinical speech models should therefore be evaluated with intervention-based robustness alongside predictive accuracy.
blocks.zh: 这些结论具有直接的实际意义: 声学因子中缺乏统计上显著的群体差异,不足以证明强性. 在我们的数据中,SNR显示没有明显的群体差异,但却产生了由干预引起的最大的翻转. 因此,临床语音模型应当与预测准确性一道,以基于干预的稳健性加以评价。

blocks.en: Our study has some limitations that motivate future work. We examine only noise and reverberation, chosen for their established role in speech processing [ 20 , 23 ] and links to AD prediction [ 30 ] . Our interventions, while spanning real and synthetic sources, are still applied post-hoc. Validating these with in-the-wild multilingual recordings would clarify generalisability of the effects.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有一些局限性,可以激励今后的工作。 我们只研究噪音和反响,选择在语音处理[20,23]中发挥其既定作用,并与AD预测[30]链接. 我们的干预虽然涉及真实的和合成的来源,但是仍然适用。 以繁多的多语种录音来验证这些记录将澄清这些影响的普遍性。

blocks.en: Overall, predictive accuracy and acoustic decodability alone are insufficient for trustworthiness. Intervention-based audits are needed to test whether predictions remain stable under acoustic variation that is clinically irrelevant but practically unavoidable.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,仅预测准确性和声学可解码性不足以保证可信赖性。 需要进行基于干预的审计,以检验预测是否在临床无关但实际上不可避免的声学变异下保持稳定。

blocks.en: 5 Compliance with Ethical Standards
blocks.zh: 5 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: This study uses existing ADReSSo data derived from the DementiaBank, collected with informed consent. All data were used in accordance with DementiaBank access requirements.
blocks.zh: 本研究利用了来自 " 死神银行 " 的现有ADReSSo数据,这些数据是在知情同意下收集的。 所有数据都按照DementiaBank访问要求使用。
